title: Occupational Physicians Facing Premenstrual Dysphoric Disorder: Knowledge, Perceptions and Practices in Occupational Health
official: Occupational Physicians Facing Premenstrual Dysphoric Disorder: Knowledge, Perceptions and Practices in Occupational Health
summary: This study aims to assess the knowledge, perceptions and practices of occupational physicians regarding premenstrual dysphoric disorder (PMDD), a condition with significant occupational impact that remains insufficiently explored in occupational health.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Occupational physicians or occupational health collaborators
* Practicing in France for at least two years
* Agreeing to participate in the study

Exclusion Criteria:

* Lack of proficiency in the French language

sites.f: Service de Psychiatrie 2 - CHU de Strasbourg - France
